findings.description: All three Windows executables returned Get-AuthenticodeSignature Status=NotSigned.
findings.root_cause: No Authenticode code-signing certificate configured in Electron Forge / PyInstaller build.
findings.impact: Clean end-user Windows machines will display SmartScreen 'Windows protected your PC' warnings.
findings.residual_risk: User friction or AV quarantine on clean machines until EV/OV code signing is applied.

findings.description: Bundled tesseract directory includes 18 training/utility EXEs (e.g., lstmtraining.exe, cntraining.exe, tesseract-uninstall.exe) alongside tesseract.exe.
findings.root_cause: Full Tesseract installation directory copied into PyInstaller bundle.

findings.description: Loop 17 test_fast_profiling_performance (1129.65 ms vs <850 ms) and Loop 18 test_new_documents_profiling_and_execution (1582.11 ms vs <1400 ms) exceed tight wall-clock targets.
findings.root_cause: Tesseract subprocess invocation latency during adaptive profiling on Windows.
findings.impact: Profiling takes ~1.1-1.6s per page; accuracy and abstention unaffected.
